invariants.rationale: Both method branches return a non-null Iterator.
If partitioner is not null and fileId is in the small file ids, result is the outcome of the superclass method.
Logical converse for the above: in the 'correction' case, the superclass result is returned.
Result is always non-null even along the 'correction' branch.
appendHandle is constructed using partitionPath and fileId; they are expected not to be null in normal usage.
